# AnimationTree tools

8 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=animation-tree`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `create_animation_tree`

Create an AnimationTree node in the current scene and attach a tree root (state machine, blend tree, or blend space)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new AnimationTree node (default: 'AnimationTree') |
| `anim_player_path` | `string` | — | NodePath to the AnimationPlayer that this AnimationTree will drive |
| `tree_root_type` | `string` | — | Type of root animation node to create (default: state_machine) One of: `"state_machine"`, `"blend_tree"`, `"blend_space_1d"`, `"blend_space_2d"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "AT",
  "anim_player_path": "AP",
  "tree_root_type": "StateMachine"
}
```

## `create_state_machine`

Set the tree_root of an AnimationTree to a new AnimationNodeStateMachine, optionally adding initial animation states

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node |
| `states` | `array` | — | Initial states to add. Each entry: { name: string, animation?: string } Array items are `object`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-02:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT",
  "states": [
    {
      "name": "Idle"
    },
    {
      "name": "Walk"
    }
  ]
}
```

## `add_transition`

Add a transition between two states in an AnimationNodeStateMachine. Use 'Start' and 'End' for the built-in entry/exit nodes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node |
| `from_state` | `string` | yes | Source state name (use 'Start' for the built-in entry node) |
| `to_state` | `string` | yes | Destination state name (use 'End' for the built-in exit node) |
| `xfade_time` | `number` | — | Cross-fade blend time in seconds (default: 0.0) |
| `switch_mode` | `string` | — | When the transition triggers (default: immediate) One of: `"immediate"`, `"sync"`, `"at_end"`. |
| `advance_condition` | `string` | — | Name of a boolean parameter that triggers the transition automatically when true |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-04:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT",
  "from_state": "Idle",
  "to_state": "Walk"
}
```

## `add_blend_tree`

Set the tree_root of an AnimationTree to a new AnimationNodeBlendTree, optionally adding blend nodes

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node |
| `nodes` | `array` | — | Blend nodes to add. Each entry: { name, type, animation?, x?, y? } Array items are `object`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-07:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT"
}
```

## `set_active_state`

Enable/disable an AnimationTree (active param), or set the initial/entry state of a StateMachine by adding a Start→state transition (state_name param)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node |
| `active` | `boolean` | — | Set AnimationTree.active to this value |
| `state_name` | `string` | — | Add a Start→state_name transition, making this state the initial entry state |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT",
  "active": true
}
```

## `get_state_machine_info`

Get detailed info about an AnimationTree: tree_root type, states, transitions, blend points

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node |
| `include_transitions` | `boolean` | — | Include transition data for StateMachine roots (default: true) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT"
}
```

## `edit_blend_space`

Add, remove, reposition, or list blend points in a BlendSpace1D or BlendSpace2D tree root

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node whose tree_root is a BlendSpace |
| `action` | `string` | — | Operation to perform One of: `"add_point"`, `"remove_point"`, `"set_point"`, `"list_points"`. |
| `animation` | `string` | — | Animation name for the blend point (add_point only) |
| `index` | `number` | — | Blend point index (remove_point / set_point) |
| `pos` | `number` | — | Position along the 1D blend axis (BlendSpace1D only) |
| `x` | `number` | — | X position on the 2D blend plane (BlendSpace2D only) |
| `y` | `number` | — | Y position on the 2D blend plane (BlendSpace2D only) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-08:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT",
  "action": "list_points"
}
```

## `delete_animation_tree_node`

Delete a state from a StateMachine (state_name param), or remove the AnimationTree node itself from the scene (no state_name)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationTree node |
| `state_name` | `string` | — | State to remove from the StateMachine. Omit to delete the AnimationTree node itself. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/09-animation-tree.json`, test AT-06:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AT",
  "state_name": "Walk"
}
```
